'''Wakana Minami''' (Japanese: '''美波わかな''' ''Minami Wakana'') is a Japanese voice actress for {{aniseries|PTS}}.

==Biography==
Minami was born on March 1, 1994, in {{wp|Shimonoseki}}, {{wp|Yamaguchi Prefecture}}, {{wp|Japan}}, and became a voice actress as an adult. She joined the {{pkmn|animated series}} during {{aniseries|SM}}, gaining several roles such as [[Piko]] and one of the members of [[Team Electric Princess]]. Her most notable role so far is that of [[Sandy]], the protagonist of the [[Where Are You Going, Eevee?]] shorts who was later {{pkmn2|caught}} by {{an|Lana}}. In addition to her work on {{aniseries|PTS}}, Minami has also worked on {{OBP|Detective Pikachu|video game}}. Minami is currently affiliated with HiBiKi. Formerly associated with {{wp|Aoni Production}}.. She used to go by her stage name Wakana Kingyo (Japanese: '''金魚わかな''' ''Kingyo Wakana'').
